title: 롤플레이 (11~13번)
intro: OPIc 11~13번은 한 상황이 질문하기(11번) → 문제 해결(12번) → 관련 경험(13번)으로 이어지는 롤플레이 구간입니다. 상대 대답 없이 혼자 말하므로 음성 메시지를 남기듯 한 번에 쭉 이어 말하면 됩니다. 상황은 늘 내 페르소나로 바꿔 생각하세요: 20년 같이 일한 동료 Minho와의 주말 영화, 아이 둘과 함께 가는 제주 가족 여행, 대전 부모님 댁 방문, 작년 여름 오사카 여행처럼 이미 준비한 이야기를 재활용하면 훨씬 자연스럽습니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장('Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.') → 내 상황 한 줄(동료 Minho와 / 가족 넷이) → 질문 3~4개 또는 문제 설명 + 대안 2개 → 마무리 문장('Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.')
11번(질문하기)은 First / Also / And one more thing 으로 질문을 3~4개 이상 이어 갑니다. 시간·가격·할인·좌석·포함 사항·주차 중에서 고르세요.
12번(문제 해결)은 'I'm afraid there's a problem with ~.' → 무슨 일이 생겼는지 한두 문장 → 'How about ~ instead? / If not, could I ~?' 로 대안 2개 이상 → 'Please call me back.' 으로 끝냅니다.
13번(경험)은 일반 경험 문제와 같습니다. 언제 → 무슨 일 → 내가 한 행동 → 결과·느낀 점을 과거시제로 말하고, 회사 급한 일 때문에 바뀐 대전 방문, 오사카 티켓 날짜 실수처럼 페르소나 이야기를 쓰세요.

expressions.en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday.
expressions.ko: 안녕하세요, 이번 주 토요일 새 SF 영화 때문에 전화드렸어요.
expressions.note: 11번 만능 시작 문장. about 뒤만 바꾸기

expressions.en: What time does the evening show start?
How much are the tickets for two adults?
Does the price include the flights?
expressions.note: include 뒤에 breakfast, a rental car 등으로 바꾸기

expressions.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with my booking.
Please call me back at this number.
There are four of us, two adults and two kids.
expressions.ko: 어른 둘, 아이 둘, 모두 네 명이에요.

expressions.en: Is it possible to move my tickets to Sunday instead?
expressions.ko: 티켓을 대신 일요일로 옮길 수 있을까요?
expressions.note: Is it possible to + 동사원형 = 정중한 요청

expressions.en: If that doesn't work, could I get a refund?
expressions.ko: 그게 안 되면 환불받을 수 있을까요?

expressions.en: Something came up, so he can't make it.
expressions.ko: 일이 생겨서 그 친구가 못 온대요.

expressions.en: I only have five days off from work.
I'd really appreciate it if you could find us another flight.
expressions.ko: 다른 항공편을 찾아 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

expressions.en: The kids have been counting down the days for weeks.
expressions.ko: 아이들이 몇 주 전부터 날짜를 손꼽아 기다렸어요.

expressions.en: Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks!
expressions.ko: 네, 여쭤보고 싶은 건 그게 다예요. 감사합니다!
expressions.note: 롤플레이 마무리 문장. 12번은 'Yeah, that's the situation.'

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to see a movie with a friend this weekend. Call the movie theater and ask three or four questions about the movie.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 이번 주말에 친구와 영화를 보려고 합니다. 영화관에 전화해서 영화에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.' → 오래 함께한 동료 Minho와 볼 거라는 상황 한 줄 → 질문 3~4개(시간·가격·할인·좌석·주차) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
질문마다 First / Also / And one more thing 을 붙이면 개수가 분명하게 들립니다.
IH 이상은 '토요일 오전엔 아이들과 시간을 보내서 저녁이 좋다', '차를 가져간다'처럼 내 상황에 맞춘 이유를 한 줄씩 붙이세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday. My coworker Minho and I want to see it together. He's also a good friend of mine. I have a few questions. First, I'd like to know what time the evening shows start. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? Do you have any discounts for members? And one more thing, are there any good seats left in the middle? Okay, thank you so much. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Bye!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday. My coworker Minho and I have worked together for almost 20 years, and we're both big sci-fi fans, so we finally decided to see it together. I have a few questions. First, I'd like to know what time the evening shows start. I usually spend Saturday mornings with my kids, so anything after six would be perfect. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? I have a membership card, so is there any discount I can use? And are there still good seats left in the middle? We don't like sitting too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, is there free parking in the building? I'm going to drive there. Okay, that's really helpful. Thank you. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Have a good day!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday. My coworker Minho and I have been dying to see it. We've worked together for almost 20 years, and we just wrapped up a really tough project, so we decided to treat ourselves to a night out. So I have a few questions, if you don't mind. First, I'd like to know what time the evening shows start. I usually take my kids to the park on Saturday mornings, so anything after six would work best. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? I've got a membership card for your theater, so I was wondering if there's any kind of discount. And are there still good seats left in the middle? Honestly, at our age, we get a sore neck if we sit too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, is the movie showing in IMAX? If it is, we'd love to see it on the big screen, since the special effects are supposed to be amazing. Lastly, is there free parking in the building, or should we just take the subway? Okay, that's super helpful. Thanks a lot for your time. So yeah, that's pretty much everything I wanted to ask. Have a great day!

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to go on a trip during your vacation. Call a travel agency and ask three or four questions about a trip package you are interested in.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 휴가 때 여행을 가려고 합니다. 여행사에 전화해서 관심 있는 여행 상품에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~ package.' → 여름휴가에 가족 넷(아이 둘)이 간다는 상황 → 질문 3~4개(가격·방·포함 사항·아이 활동) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
가족 여행이라 'for two adults and two kids', 'activities for kids' 같은 질문이 자연스럽습니다.
AL은 취소 규정(cancellation policy)처럼 직장인다운 질문을 하나 더 넣고 이유를 붙이세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about your Jeju Island package. I want to go there with my family during my summer vacation. There are four of us, two adults and two kids. I have a few questions. First, how much is the package for four people? Also, is it possible to get a room with an ocean view? Does the price include the flights and a rental car? And one more thing, are there any fun activities for kids? Okay, thank you. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the Jeju Island package I saw on your website. I'm planning a trip with my family during my summer vacation in August. There are four of us, including my son, who's in middle school, and my daughter, who's in elementary school. So I have a few questions. First, how much is the four-day package for two adults and two kids? Also, is it possible to get a room with an ocean view? My kids love waking up and seeing the sea. Next, does the price include the flights and a rental car? We definitely need a car to get around the island. And one more thing, are there any activities for kids, like horse riding or a water park? Okay, that sounds great. Could you send me the details by email? Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks a lot!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about the Jeju Island package I saw on your website. I'm planning a family trip for my summer vacation in early August. There are four of us in total, including my son, who's in middle school, and my daughter, who's in elementary school. We went to Jeju a few years ago and had a blast, so the kids have been begging to go back. Anyway, I have a few questions, if you don't mind. First, how much is the four-day package for two adults and two kids? Also, is it possible to get a room with an ocean view? Last time our room faced the parking lot, which was a bit disappointing. Next, does the price include the round-trip flights and a rental car? To be honest, getting around the island without a car is a real pain. And one more thing, are there any activities for kids, like horse riding or snorkeling? My son gets bored pretty easily, so that would be a big plus. Lastly, what's your cancellation policy? Things come up at work all the time, so I'd like to know just in case. Okay, that's really helpful. Could you email me all the details? So yeah, that's pretty much everything I wanted to ask. Thanks so much!

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You bought two movie tickets for this weekend, but your friend just told you that something came up and they can't come. Call the theater, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 죄송하지만 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 이번 주말 영화 티켓 두 장을 샀는데, 친구가 방금 일이 생겨서 못 온다고 합니다. 영화관에 전화해서 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling about ~.' → 'I'm afraid there's a problem with ~.' → Minho의 아들이 아파서 못 온다는 상황 설명 → 대안 2~3개 → 'Yeah, that's the situation.'
대안은 How about ~ instead? / Is it possible to ~? / If that doesn't work, could I ~? 로 하나씩 꺼내세요.
IH 이상은 '대신 중학생 아들을 데려갈 수 있게 청소년 티켓으로 바꿔 달라'처럼 내 가족 상황을 대안에 넣으면 자연스럽습니다.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling about my movie tickets. I'm afraid there's a problem with the two tickets I booked for Saturday. My friend Minho just told me that he can't come because his son is sick. So I have a couple of ideas. First, how about moving my tickets to Sunday evening instead? If that's not possible, could I get a refund for one ticket? Please call me back at this number. Thank you so much. Yeah, that's the situation. Bye!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling about the movie tickets I booked on your app. I'm afraid there's a problem with the two tickets I booked for Saturday at seven. My coworker Minho was supposed to come with me, but he just called and said his son is sick, so he has to stay home. I totally understand, but now I have an extra ticket. So I have a couple of ideas. First, how about moving both tickets to Sunday evening instead? Minho said he'd be free then. If that doesn't work, could I change the second ticket to a youth ticket? Then I could bring my son instead. He's a big sci-fi fan too. Please call me back at this number when you get a chance. Thanks a lot. Yeah, that's the situation. Have a good day!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling about the movie tickets I booked through your app. I'm afraid there's a problem with the two tickets I booked for this Saturday at seven. My coworker Minho and I were really looking forward to it, but he just called me and said his son came down with a fever, so he has to stay home and take care of him. Of course, family comes first, so I totally get it. The thing is, the tickets are non-refundable on the app, so I'm kind of stuck. So I have a few ideas. First, how about moving both tickets to Sunday evening instead? Minho said his son should be feeling better by then. If that's not possible, could I change the second ticket to a youth ticket? My son is in middle school, and he's been begging me to see this movie, so I could bring him instead. And if neither of those works, could you give me store credit for the extra ticket so I can use it next time? Please call me back at this number whenever you get a chance. I'd really appreciate your help. So yeah, that's pretty much the situation. Thanks so much!

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You booked a trip through a travel agency, but you just found out that your flight has been canceled. Call the travel agency, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 죄송하지만 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 여행사를 통해 여행을 예약했는데, 방금 항공편이 취소된 것을 알게 되었습니다. 여행사에 전화해서 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling about my ~ trip.' → 가족 넷의 제주행 비행기가 취소됐다는 설명 → 대안 2~3개(다른 시간 비행기, 다른 항공사, 일정 연기) → 'Yeah, that's the situation.'
'I only have five days off from work.' 처럼 직장인이라 일정이 빠듯하다는 이유를 넣으면 급한 느낌이 잘 삽니다.
마지막은 'I'd really appreciate it if you could ~.' + 'Please call me back.' 으로 정중하게 끝내세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling about my Jeju trip. I booked a package with your agency for my family. But I just found out that our flight tomorrow morning has been canceled. I'm afraid there's a problem with our whole schedule now. So I have two ideas. First, can we take a later flight tomorrow? Or, is it possible to move the trip to next weekend? I'd really appreciate it if you could find us another flight to Jeju. Please call me back soon. Yeah, that's the situation. Thanks!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling about the Jeju package I booked with your agency last month. It's for the four of us, two adults and two kids. I just got a text message saying that our flight tomorrow morning has been canceled because of a problem with the plane. I'm really worried because we already booked the hotel and the rental car, and I only have five days off from work. So I have a couple of ideas. First, is it possible to put us on a later flight tomorrow, maybe in the afternoon? If there are no seats, could we move the whole trip back by one day? Then you'd need to change the hotel and the car too. I'd really appreciate it if you could find us another flight to Jeju. Please call me back as soon as you can. Thank you. Yeah, that's the situation.
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling about the Jeju package I booked with your agency last month. It's for the four of us, two adults and two kids, leaving tomorrow morning at eight. I'm afraid there's a big problem. I just got a text from the airline saying our flight has been canceled because of a technical issue with the plane. To be honest, I'm pretty stressed out right now. I only managed to get five days off from work, and the kids have been counting down the days for weeks. So I have a few ideas. First, is it possible to put us on a later flight tomorrow? Even an evening flight would be totally fine. If that's not possible, could you book us on a different airline? I don't mind paying a little extra if it means we can still leave tomorrow. And if neither of those options works, could we push the whole trip back by one day and change the hotel and rental car to match? I'd really appreciate it if you could find us another flight to Jeju as soon as possible. Please call me back at this number. I'll keep my phone on. So yeah, that's the situation. Thanks so much!

questions.en: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a plan canceled or changed at the last minute? Tell me what happened and how you handled it.
questions.ko: 상황극은 여기까지입니다. 계획이 마지막 순간에 취소되거나 바뀐 적이 있나요? 무슨 일이 있었고 어떻게 대처했는지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Oh, yes, that happened to me ~.' → 언제·어떤 계획(대전 부모님 댁, 아버지 생신) → 무슨 일(회사 시스템 장애로 팀 리드인 내가 출근) → 대처와 결과 → 'Yeah, that's how I handled it.'
과거시제를 지키고 Something unexpected happened when ~ / I ended up ~ 같은 패턴으로 이야기를 이어 가세요.
AL은 미안했던 감정, 가족의 반응, 그 뒤로 달라진 점(팀원 교육)까지 넣으면 좋습니다.

answers.IM3: Oh, yes, that happened to me last spring. We planned to visit my parents in Daejeon for my dad's birthday. Something unexpected happened when we were about to leave for Daejeon. I got a call from my office. There was a big problem with our system, and I'm the team leader, so I had to go in. I felt really bad. So my family took the KTX train without me. I fixed the problem that night and drove to Daejeon the next morning. Yeah, that's how I handled it.
answers.IH: Oh, yes, that happened to me last spring. It was my dad's 70th birthday, so we planned to drive to my parents' place in Daejeon on Saturday morning. Something unexpected happened when we were about to leave for Daejeon. We were putting our bags in the car when my phone rang. It was a guy from my team. Our main service was down, and thousands of users couldn't log in. Since I'm the team leader, I couldn't just ignore it. My kids were really disappointed, and I felt terrible. So we changed the plan. My family took the KTX train to Daejeon, and I drove to the office. My team and I fixed the problem by around ten at night. The next morning, I drove down to Daejeon and joined the party for lunch. Yeah, that's how I handled it.
answers.AL: Oh, yes, that happened to me last spring, and it was pretty stressful. It was my dad's 70th birthday, which is a really big deal in Korea, so we planned to drive down to my parents' place in Daejeon on Saturday morning. Something unexpected happened when we were about to leave for Daejeon. We were literally loading our bags into the car when my phone started ringing. It was one of the developers on my team, and he sounded panicked. Our main service had crashed, and thousands of users couldn't log in. Since I'm the team leader, there was no way I could just ignore it. My kids looked so disappointed, and honestly, I felt like the worst parent in the world. So we came up with a plan B. My family took the KTX train to Daejeon, and I headed to the office. My team and I worked on the problem all day, and we finally fixed it at around ten at night. I got up at six the next morning, drove down to Daejeon, and made it just in time for the birthday lunch. My dad just laughed and said he was proud of me. After that, I trained two people on my team to handle emergencies like that. Yeah, that's how I handled it.

questions.en: That's the end of the situation. Have you ever had a problem with a ticket, a reservation, or something you bought? Tell me what the problem was and how you solved it.
questions.ko: 상황극은 여기까지입니다. 티켓이나 예약, 산 물건에 문제가 생긴 적이 있나요? 어떤 문제였고 어떻게 해결했는지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Sure, let me tell you about one time ~.' → 작년 여름 가족 오사카 여행 → 유니버설 스튜디오 티켓 날짜를 잘못 고른 문제 → 해결과 결과 → 'Yeah, that's what happened.'
Luckily, ~ / I ended up ~ / Since then, I always make sure to ~ 로 해결과 교훈을 연결하세요.
IH 이상은 입구에서 당황한 아이들 반응, 직원과 나눈 대화를 짧게 넣으면 생생해집니다.

answers.IM3: Sure, let me tell you about one time. Last summer, my family went to Osaka. I bought Universal Studios tickets online before the trip. But at the gate, the staff said our tickets were for the next day! I chose the wrong date by mistake. My kids were almost crying. Luckily, the staff were really kind, and they changed the date for a small fee. We had a great day in the end. Since then, I always make sure to double-check the date before I pay. Yeah, that's what happened.
answers.IH: Sure, let me tell you about one time. Last summer, my family took a trip to Osaka, and the main event was Universal Studios. My kids had been talking about it for months, so I bought the tickets online a few weeks before the trip. On the day, we got there early, but at the gate, the staff told me our tickets were for the next day. I was so embarrassed. I'd chosen the wrong date on the website. My daughter started to cry, and my son just stared at me. I didn't know what to do, so I went to the ticket office and explained everything. Luckily, the staff member was really kind. She changed our tickets to that day, and we only had to pay a small fee. In the end, the kids had the best day ever. Since then, I always make sure to double-check the date before I pay. Yeah, that's what happened.
answers.AL: Sure, let me tell you about one time that still makes me laugh, even though it wasn't funny back then. Last summer, my family took a trip to Osaka, and the highlight of the whole trip was supposed to be Universal Studios. My kids had been talking about it for months, so I booked the tickets online a few weeks in advance and felt pretty proud of myself for being so organized. On the day, we got there right when the park opened, but when the staff scanned our tickets, they told me the tickets were for the next day. My heart just sank. It turned out I'd clicked the wrong date on the website, which is kind of embarrassing for someone who's been a software developer for 20 years. My daughter burst into tears, and my son gave me a look I'll never forget. I didn't know what to do, so I took a deep breath, went to the ticket office, and explained the whole situation. Luckily, the staff member was super understanding. She switched our tickets to that day, and we only had to pay a small fee. We ended up staying until the fireworks at night. Since then, I always make sure to double-check the date before I pay. Yeah, that's what happened.

pronunciation.tip: 명사는 앞 '리'에 강세. f는 윗니를 아랫입술에 대고
'캔슬드'처럼 두 음절. ed를 '에드'로 따로 읽지 않기

patterns.ko: 바다가 보이는 방으로 받을 수 있을까요?

patterns.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with the two tickets I booked for Saturday.
patterns.ko: 죄송하지만 토요일로 예매한 티켓 두 장에 문제가 있어요.

patterns.en: How about moving my tickets to Sunday evening instead?
patterns.ko: 대신 티켓을 일요일 저녁으로 옮기면 어떨까요?

patterns.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could find us another flight to Jeju.
patterns.ko: 제주로 가는 다른 항공편을 찾아 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

patterns.en: Something unexpected happened when we were about to leave for Daejeon.
patterns.ko: 대전으로 막 출발하려는데 예상치 못한 일이 생겼어요.

patterns.en: Since then, I always make sure to double-check the date before I pay.
patterns.ko: 그 뒤로는 결제하기 전에 항상 날짜를 다시 확인해요.
